## Context / Problem

`rebar store compact --help` lists `--threshold N` for the store-wide form (`[--all] [--threshold N] ...`, "compact only above N events"), but the `--all` path rejects it. Observed 2026-11-09 against the production MCP build 0f409b946e4:

- `rebar store compact --all --dry-run --threshold 8` -> `Error: unknown option '--threshold'`.
- The single-ticket form accepts only `--threshold=N` (`src/rebar/_commands/compact.py:46,92`).
- `REBAR_COMPACT_THRESHOLD=8 rebar store compact --all --dry-run` works.

An operator following the help text can't scope a store-wide sweep's threshold.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `rebar store compact --all` accepts `--threshold N` and `--threshold=N` as its help states (or the help states what it accepts); a test pins help text and parser behaviour together.
- [x] The single-ticket form accepts both spellings too.
